text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired for svc-embeddings-eu — elevated 5xx rate observed. PD incident INC-20260317-1. auto-tags: region=eu-west-1 priority=high

pagerduty: Alert escalated to on-call rotation (primary: ash_k). Please acknowledge.

ash_k: taking this — starting triage now.

ash_k: quick check: 5xx spike (~20% of requests) on ingest path, seems concentrated on embed-worker pods 2-4.

maria.s: @ash_k any customer-facing impact? queued requests?

evan: digging into logs / metrics. redis queue length ~540, latency 95th -> 3.8s. logs show repeated resource errors and proxy resets. snippet:
```
kubectl logs deploy/embed-worker-3 -n prod --tail=40
E 2026-03-17T10:03:45Z worker: OOM killed process pid=2345
E 2026-03-17T10:04:01Z proxy: connection reset by peer
```

evan: also see increased memory pressure on hosts eu-host-22/23. not a full node failure though.

ash_k: ok scaling workers and turning on fallback routing to reduce customer latencies. will apply quick mitigations then follow up.

ash_k: running: `kubectl scale deployment embeddings-worker --replicas=6 -n prod` and `redwoodctl route set svc-embeddings-eu --fallback-model embed-small-v1 --region eu-west-1`

pagerduty: Alert acknowledged by ash_k.

kevin_w: if workers OOMing, reduce max_batch_size and bump quantization flag to use int8 for hot path. I'll push a small config patch to the configmap.

kevin_w: patch command: `kubectl patch configmap embeddings-config -n prod --patch '{"data":{"max_batch_size":"8","quantize":"int8"}}'`

maria.s: pinged CS and SRE runbook for affected customers. CS ticket #CS-789 created, customers informed of degraded performance but no data loss.

ash_k: 5m update: replicas up, fallback routing active, memory pressure dropping. 5xx rate down ~60%, queue length now ~160. monitoring for 15m before close. :white_check_mark:

evan: metrics: 5xx rate trend moving down. looks like proxy resets stopped after fallback.

ash_k: 20m update: system stable for 15m, queue drained to <50, 5xx baseline restored. will keep a watch for another 30m then clear PD.

incidentbot: INC-20260317-1 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. severity lowered to P2.

maria.s: thanks all — final note to CS: we'll share RCA draft once SRE completes deeper postmortem.
